fields.processing_time: Embassy of Japan/JVAC in Moscow: normally 4–5 working days; the mission describes 4 working days as a minimum. Its September 2026 notice warns that the Japanese holidays on 21–23 September may extend processing to 10 days including weekends. Apply well in advance; additional examination can take longer. For another consular jurisdiction in Russia, follow that office's published timing.
fields.application_channel_detail: For applications in Russia, submit at the Japan Visa Centre in person or through an authorised representative. The embassy does not accept visa applications by post.
exceptions: Russian citizens must obtain the appropriate visa before travel unless they already hold an applicable re-entry permit.
The government visa fee is waived for Russian citizens; visa-centre service charges may be separate.
fields.consular_jurisdiction: Apply at the Japanese Embassy or Consulate General with jurisdiction over your place of residence. Applying outside your country or region of residence is a stated ground for refusing to accept the application.
